description: The fatal open, from a customer master that is not there to be opened. The case declares no CUSTFILE input at all, which is how it states that - a dataset a case says nothing about is omitted from "inputs" entirely. 0000-CUSTFILE-OPEN at app/cbl/CBCUS01C.cbl:L118-L134 moves 8 into APPL-RESULT before the OPEN, sees a status other than '00', moves 12, and takes its ELSE arm: DISPLAY 'ERROR OPENING CUSTFILE', then MOVE CUSTFILE-STATUS TO IO-STATUS and Z-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS, then Z-ABEND-PROGRAM. The status is rendered through the extended branch at L162-L168 because its first byte is '9', giving FILE STATUS IS: NNNN9000, and the CALL 'CEE3ABD' at L158 carries APPL-RESULT 12 out as the RETURN-CODE. No record is read, no display fires, 9000-CUSTFILE-CLOSE is never performed and the L85 banner is never reached.
